svg.aria-label: Projects from the 42 Common Core: webserv: HTTP/1.1 server written from scratch in C++98: one poll() loop, non-blocking sockets, CGI and uploads; minishell: Bash-like Unix shell with pipes, redirections, environment variables and signal handling; ft_transcendence: Single-page Pong website in TypeScript: 1v1, tournaments and an AI opponent, served by nginx over HTTPS; Inception: Three-container WordPress stack with Docker Compose: NGINX (TLS 1.2/1.3), php-fpm and MariaDB; Born2beroot: Hardened Debian server in a VM: encrypted LVM, UFW firewall, SSH on a custom port, strict sudo policy; Philosophers: Dining philosophers simulation with threads and mutexes, free of data races and deadlocks; cub3D: Wolfenstein-style 3D engine rendered with raycasting on MiniLibX; +9 more: Libft · ft_printf · get_next_line · push_swap · Minitalk · pipex · so_long · NetPractice · CPP Modules 00–09.
